story_title: SPM-53: As a ConnectSphere user, I want to receive notifications about significant events affecting me so that I am aware of important changes and actions required.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an Event Organiser submits an event request, when it is submitted, then every active Event Coordinator Lead is notified, naming the event.
The Event Organiser who owns the event is notified when the assigned Event Coordinator requests clarification, with the clarification message.
The assigned Event Coordinator is notified when the Event Organiser responds to an open clarification request.
The Event Organiser who owns the event is notified when the assigned Event Coordinator approves or rejects it, with the reason for a rejection. No other user is notified of the outcome.
The Event Organiser who owns the event is notified when an Event Coordinator is assigned, with the Coordinator's name.
The newly assigned Coordinator is notified of the assignment.

Given an event is reassigned to a different Coordinator, when the reassignment is saved, then the newly assigned Coordinator and the Event Organiser are notified as for an assignment, and the previously assigned Coordinator is notified that the event is no longer theirs.
Every active Venue Staff user is notified when a venue booking request is submitted for review.
The assigned Event Coordinator is notified when Venue Staff approve or reject a venue booking request for the event, with the venue, the requested times and, for a rejection, the reason.

Every active Technical Support Staff user is notified when the assigned Event Coordinator adds, removes or changes the quantity of an equipment requirement on an event in Planning or Confirmed (the events listed in the Equipment Requests queue, SPM-48).
The assigned Event Coordinator is notified when Technical Support Staff mark an equipment requirement Reserved, Partially fulfilled or Cannot be provided.
The assigned Event Coordinator is notified when the Event Organiser submits a change request.
The Event Organiser is notified of the outcome of a change request, including the outcome for each field where it is partially approved.

Given an important change (date and time, expected attendance, venue requirements or equipment) is saved by the assigned Coordinator or applied from an approved change request, when it is saved, then the Event Organiser who owns the event is notified, naming which of these changed. No other user is notified of the change by this criterion.
The Event Organiser who owns the event is notified when the event moves from Confirmed back to Planning (an important change, SPM-62, or a safety check closed after a change, SPM-88).

An Attendee is notified when they are registered for an event, including when the Event Coordinator adds them (SPM-57), and when an event they are registered for is Postponed or Cancelled (see the confirmed, completed, postponed or cancelled criterion below).
Attendees whose registration is Registered are notified of the new date and time when an event is rescheduled.

The Event Organiser who owns the event is notified when it is Confirmed, Completed, Postponed or Cancelled. Attendees whose registration is Registered are notified when it is Postponed or Cancelled. For Postponed and Cancelled, the notification includes the recorded reason.
Each notification is delivered in the system as it is raised and appears in the recipient's notification list (see: View Notifications, SPM-71).
Notifications are associated with the relevant event.

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: Every new notification is about its event and opens the event's Overview when selected (SPM-71's rule for any type it does not send elsewhere).

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: AC10 is judged on the event's status after the change, so the first equipment requirement on an Approved event, which moves it to Planning (SPM-54), notifies Technical Support. Changing only an equipment line's technical requirements notifies nobody (AC10 names adds, removals and quantity changes).

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: Equipment is one of AC14's important changes, and SPM-62 already treats every saved change to an equipment requirement (including its technical requirements) as one, moving a Confirmed event back to Planning. So each such save tells the organiser 'Event information changed' naming 'Equipment requirements', and 'Event no longer confirmed' when it moved a Confirmed event back (AC15). Technical Support hear only of adds, removals and quantity changes (AC10).

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: AC17 'rescheduled' is any change to the event's date or time, whether the coordinator saves it (SPM-62) or it is applied from an approved change request (SPM-32, including a Postponed event given its new date).
RESOLVED 2026-10-29: AC16 'registered' includes an attendee who accepts a waiting-list offer (SPM-66), since that registers them. Joining the waiting list is not registering and notifies nobody.
RESOLVED 2026-10-29: AC18 Completed includes an event the 7-day sweep completes (SPM-36 AC6). It has no manual case, since the sweep acts on an event 7 days after it ends; the unit tests cover it.

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: AC15's second route, a safety check closed after a change (SPM-88), moves an event from Safety review or Safety approved to Planning, never from Confirmed, so only an important change to a Confirmed event (SPM-62) raises 'Event no longer confirmed'.

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: AC16's 'including when the Event Coordinator adds them (SPM-57)' cannot be built or tested until SPM-57 (Manually Add Attendee, PR #92) is merged. Whoever merges second adds the notification to the coordinator's add, using the 'Registration confirmed' wording.

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: At least one case per acceptance criterion (Sammi Chua), each short; a case that follows on the same event continues from the one before it rather than repeating its setup. Per-branch detail (no title, refused requests, a reason ending in a full stop) is in the unit tests.
